# Observed fee regression inputs

Raw case, expected amount and receipt files are unchanged from the captured
Yearn fees benchmark at f3bb4bade3ba62ae24bb1af28f37d628447997eb.
Inventory metadata is a selected subset for the observed regression cases,
including older fee-evidence cases. It is not the original full cohort and
makes no discovery/completeness claim. The manifest hashes describe these
files, not the original capture. Retired metadata and unavailable values
remain explicit. Benchmark estimates do not override verified fee acceptance.
